title: From 1,000,000 Users to Every User: Scaling Up Personalized Preference for User-level Alignment

bias_targets.methodology: Comparing LLM-generated preference direction labels against human crowdsourced annotations and predictions from other LLMs (e.g., GPT-4 vs. Qwen2.5) to identify systematic biases introduced during automated data labeling.

Conducting a case study to analyze the co-occurrence distribution of 'Gender' and the 'Need for Succorance' attribute in the dataset to check if the constructed data introduces imbalanced societal stereotypes.
